name: Amlodipine
executiveSummary: Dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker. Adult: **5 mg PO/day** (range **2.5–10 mg/day**). Pediatrics ≥6 y: start **2.5 mg/day** or **0.06–0.3 mg/kg/day** (max **10 mg**). Ankle edema common; little bradycardia vs non-DHP.
indications:
## Indications

- Hypertension; stable / vasospastic angina (label).

## Precautions

- Dose-dependent peripheral edema (not necessarily HF).
- Hypotension; caution in severe aortic stenosis.
- CYP3A4 interactions (↑ levels with strong inhibitors).
- Compatible with many ACEI/ARB/thiazide regimens.

> Long half-life — full effect over several days.

adulto.dose: Start **5 mg PO/day** (elderly/hepatic **2.5 mg**). Titrate every 7–14 days up to max **10 mg/day**.
adulto.administration: PO once daily, any time, with or without food.
adulto.notes: Avoid abrupt stop in angina (rebound uncommon but possible).

pediatrico.dose: ≥6 y: start **2.5 mg/day**; usual **0.06–0.3 mg/kg/day** (max **5–10 mg/day** per label).

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Ankle edema, flushing, headache, palpitations, fatigue; rare: gingival hyperplasia, hepatitis.
